**Job Description Summary

**As a Service Account Leader at GE HealthCare, you will play a key role in growing our service business across Denmark. By building trusted customer relationships and delivering innovative lifecycle solutions, you will help healthcare providers maximize equipment uptime, optimize operational performance, and deliver exceptional patient care.

Working closely with local sales and service teams, you will identify new business opportunities, develop strategic service offerings, and drive sustainable growth across our Imaging, Ultrasound, and Patient Care Solutions portfolio. The role combines commercial leadership, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic international environment.

**Responsibilities

****Job Description

**

• Sell point-of-sale service contracts and solutions while protecting margin by communicating value and maintaining pricing discipline.

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of GE HealthCare’s service solutions and relevant competitive offerings.

• Develop account penetration strategies for key target accounts and competitive accounts. Share market intelligence, field concerns, emerging issues, and customer requirements with the wider business.

• Lead customer negotiations and close deals by engaging key buying stakeholders, including technical and biomedical personnel, department heads, and C-suite executives.

• Achieve annual and quarterly revenue targets by maintaining accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts, prioritizing selling time effectively, increasing sales volume, deepening account penetration, and ensuring comprehensive territory coverage.

• Maintain strong after-sales relationships, develop long-term customer partnerships, and identify opportunities that address both immediate and evolving customer needs.

**Qualifications/Requirements

**

• At least one of the following core experiences:

• Consultative sales or marketing experience, including strategic selling and negotiation in a complex sales environment involving multiple decision-makers and influencers.

• Healthcare service experience, preferably in Diagnostic Imaging, Ultrasound, or Patient Care Solutions.

• Experience in one or more customer-facing roles.

• Excellent written and spoken Danish and English language skills.

• Willingness to travel within the assigned geographic region.

**Desired Skills

**

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Previous Healthcare sales experience.

• Robust interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to work independently as well as with a team.

• Strong written and verbal communication and clear thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex issues into simple messages.

• Solid process orientation, demonstrated resource management and allocation experience, and the ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.

• Experience interfacing with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution-based sales process.

**Inclusion and Diversity

**GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

**Behaviours

**We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

**Total Rewards

**Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions that help our customers decarbonize while staying resilient and competitive. Our Controls and Thermal Management division combines heat exchanger expertise with technologies for refrigeration, cooling and air conditioning, serving customers across HVAC, refrigeration and industrial applications.

In this role, you’ll lead our European Sales team for Brazed, Gasketed and Welded Heat Exchangers and play a key role in accelerating growth across both existing customers and new markets.

Your impact? You’ll shape and execute our European sales strategy, strengthen how we go to market, and continue the transformation toward a modern, data-driven sales organization with customer experience at its core.

Working closely with regional and global stakeholders, you’ll combine commercial leadership, market insights and strong customer engagement to turn opportunities into sustainable business growth.

We would prefer you to be located close to one of our main hubs in Kolding, Denmark, Kamnik, Slovenia, or Hamburg, Germany. Remote work may be considered for the right candidate, and we are open to supporting relocation.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead, develop and empower a European team of technical sales engineers and business developers to deliver sustainable sales growth.

• Shape and execute sales plans based on market insights, customer buying behavior and business priorities, working closely with regional and global stakeholders.

• Develop existing accounts and turn new leads, markets and customer opportunities into business growth.

• Build strong customer relationships through regular market engagement, identifying customer needs and demonstrating the value of our products and solutions.

• Drive a disciplined, data-driven sales approach through consistent use of CRM, forecasting and sales processes to support agile decision-making.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or equivalent knowledge and experience, combined with significant experience in sales, engineering or business development.

• Strong commercial and strategic capabilities, with the ability to analyze markets, competitors and opportunities and translate insights into effective business strategies.

• Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage customers, partners and diverse internal stakeholders.

• Knowledge of HVAC and/or industrial applications and markets, supported by solid analytical capabilities.

• A flexible and resourceful approach to changing market conditions, with the ability to navigate challenges and identify opportunities for growth.

The role requires approximately 20–40% travel, primarily within Europe.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about. We think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Senior Frontend Engineer - with an interest in fullstack
jobs.description:
About Cardlay
Cardlay is a Danish fintech building white-label card and spend management solutions. Banks, issuers and financial partners in Europe and the US offer our platform to their business customers using their own brand.

We are a small dedicated team with short decision paths. We make bold decisions, turn them into results by helping each other, and give people the mandate to own what they build.
About the job
Our web portal is where companies run their spend: cards, expenses, accounting and people management. Every bank offers it under its own brand.

Some of the core capabilities include

• Cards: card programs, card orders and requests, and funding accounts
• Expenses: transactions, receipts, mileages and expense policies
• Accounting: categories, cost dimensions, GL accounts and exports to external accounting systems
• People and teams: onboarding, invitations, roles and company settings
Under the hood, it's React, TypeScript, pnpm workspaces and Vite.

Every new bank brings its own brand and requirements, and AI agents now write a growing share of our code. We need a senior engineer who builds the product and keeps the shared components and patterns behind them consistent, so new screens, whether built by people or AI agents, look and work like the rest of the product.

This is a hands-on product role with significant ownership: you will build features every day and help set our frontend direction.

What success looks like after a year

• Customers use features you built and shipped end to end
• A new feature takes less code and fewer review rounds than it does today
• New screens are built from shared components by default, by people and AI agents alike
• The core libraries are up to date with latest security updates and we are on a clear upgrade path going forward
The challenge

Customers rely on the platform every day, and it has grown over several years:

• Some pages use our new design system and some don't yet. Deciding what to migrate, and when, to keep the experience consistent is ongoing work
• You work closely with our UI/UX Lead. That takes the confidence to push back on designs that hurt the user experience, and the taste to know when you're right
• There are several ways of handling data and state in the codebase, and picking the right one for each case directly affects what customers experience
• We're a small team, and other developers contribute a lot to the web portal. As the senior frontend engineer, you decide what's good enough to merge and where our code style and stack go next
• You look beyond your own domain. When the answer is on the other side of the API, you read the backend code and unblock yourself where you canWhat you'll do
As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will own the frontend of our web portal. You take responsibility for what we ship, make decisions others can build on, drive projects forward and help the people around you grow.

You will be the primary frontend engineer in an engineering team of 10 people across frontend, backend, mobile and DevOps. You will work closely with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and report to our Head of Engineering.

Your responsibilities will include

• Take responsibility for the frontend as a whole: its quality, performance and direction
• Make the key frontend decisions and stand by them: architecture, what goes into the design system and when to say no
• Drive projects from idea to production with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and own them until customers are using them
• Build reusable components and patterns as part of your product work, not one-off solutions
• Move legacy screens onto the design system as you work on them, without silent visual regressions
• Set up component APIs, lint rules and docs so AI agents produce code that fits
• Mentor other engineers and share what you know through reviews, docs and pairingWho you are
We are looking for an experienced frontend engineer who loves building a product and cares about the quality and consistency behind it.

You likely bring

• Deep experience with React and TypeScript
• You have shipped complex features in a web product that customers rely on
• You use AI coding tools every day and know where they go wrong
• A good eye for UX and product quality
• You speak up when something could be done better, and you see your work through to production
• You have driven projects with other engineers and helped them grow through mentoring and reviews
Bonus if you have

• Experience building component libraries or design systems
• Design tokens or white-label theming
• Interest in fullstack work, so you can help out on the backend when you can
• Experience from fintech or complex B2B products
You will work with the technologies below. We don't expect experience with all of them; we are looking for engineers who learn quickly.

• React, TypeScript
• Vite, pnpm workspaces, Biome
• MUI, styled-components, Storybook
• TanStack Query, TanStack Table, Redux Toolkit
• React Hook Form, react-intl
• Vitest, MSW, CypressWhy Cardlay
You will join at a point where our platform is proven, our customer base is growing and AI is changing how we build software. You will have a real say in how Cardlay builds the frontend, in a team where senior engineers set the direction.

• Permanent employment, freelance or consultancy, with salary or rate matching experience
• Hybrid work from our offices in Copenhagen or Odense
• English as our main working language, with Danish spoken too. You don't need to speak Danish to join
• Flexible working hours, and the option to work from home when it suits you and the team
• Company-paid phone and home internet
• Lunch, coffee, fruit, drinks and snacks at the officeHow to apply
Go ahead and hit "apply" and upload your résumé, application and other relevant information through our HR system.

Any questions about the position can be directed to our Head of Engineering:

Magnus Biolzi Hansen, Mail: mbh@cardlay.com, Telephone: +45 42 28 62 42

Application deadline: We review applications as they come in and will close the position once we've found the right person.

jobs.occupation: Produktionskoordinator & Creative Specialist – barselsvikariat / Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Hos AVdesign i Billund søger vi en erfaren produktionskoordinator til et barselsvikariat i vores videoteam.

Du skal være god til at planlægge, holde overblik og få produktionerne til at hænge sammen – også når der kommer ændringer undervejs. Du får tæt kontakt med vores kunder og kolleger og deltager både i koordineringen og de praktiske opgaver i studiet og på location.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af vores produktioner. Vi arbejder med video, livestreaming, produktoptagelser i studiet og andre medieproduktioner. Opgaverne varierer, og du skal have lyst til at hjælpe til, hvor der er brug for dig.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som producer, produktionsleder eller koordinator og er vant til at holde styr på planer, mennesker og deadlines.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

• 
Planlægge og koordinere produktioner i samarbejde med teamet.

• 
Holde styr på tidsplaner, logistik og praktiske aftaler.

• 
Have løbende kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere og sikre, at de er godt informeret undervejs.

• 
Deltage i produktionerne og hjælpe med praktiske og kreative opgaver.

• 
Følge op på opgaver og sørge for, at projekterne bliver leveret til tiden.

• 
Håndtere ændringer og finde løsninger, når noget ikke går som planlagt.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, idéer og erfaringer.

Om dig

Du arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og kolleger og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver skal løses samtidig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

• 
Har erfaring med koordinering, projektarbejde, administration eller produktionsplanlægning.

• 
Er god til at planlægge og holde styr på flere projekter og deadlines.

• 
Er omhyggelig og har øje for detaljerne.

• 
Tager ansvar og selv følger op på det, der mangler.

• 
Kan tilpasse dig, når planer og prioriteringer ændrer sig.

• 
Har lyst til en hverdag med forskellige opgaver og både koordinering og praktisk arbejde.

• 
Er en god kollega, der samarbejder og hjælper til.

Erfaring med video, livestreaming eller broadcast er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder lettere billedbehandling, videoredigering eller grundlæggende grafisk arbejde. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om AVdesign

AVdesign er en international produktionsvirksomhed i Billund, grundlagt i 2005. Vi er 16 kolleger inden for blandt andet animation, filmproduktion, lyd og produktionsledelse og løser opgaver for kunder over hele verden.

Du bliver en del af vores videoteam på seks personer. Vi går op i vores fag, godt samarbejde og muligheden for at udvikle os både fagligt og personligt.

Vi deler lokaler med My Instore Radio og er samlet 26 kolleger med forskellige nationaliteter.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet er Billund, og stillingen kræver fysisk fremmøde.

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til application@avdesign.dk. Har du spørgsmål, er du også velkommen til at skrive.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når stillingen er besat.

jobs.occupation: Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?
jobs.description:
Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?

At Gram Equipment, we develop and deliver equipment for industrial ice cream production worldwide. We are looking for an engineering student to join our Project Management team in Kolding, either as an intern or a student worker.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues and gain insight into how we coordinate projects, from technical requirements and planning to delivery. Along the way, you will learn how mechanical solutions, customer expectations, budgets and deadlines influence project decisions.

What you will be doing
You will support our project managers in their daily work, with tasks adapted to your skills, interests and study requirements. Your tasks may include:

• Supporting project planning and following up on milestones, deadlines and outstanding actions.
• Preparing and updating project documentation, status reports and meeting materials.
• Participating in project meetings and following up on agreed actions.
• Helping coordinate activities across Engineering, Sales, Production, Installation and Service.
• Supporting the follow-up on project costs, changes and risks.
• Contributing ideas to improve project processes and ways of working.

We are extra[not]ordinary

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers an opportunity to develop beyond inspection readiness. You will work closely with the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and support selected functional initiatives, providing exposure to broader activities across the organization and our CMO and vendor network. In parallel, you will have the opportunity to build your GMP and clinical supply knowledge by learning and supporting selected operational activities related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

The position reports to the Director, Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing based in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing with selected functional initiatives and tasks across the organization.

• Support activities related to our external CMO and vendor network, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Build knowledge of GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and learn and support selected operational tasks related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible to be compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

Requirements

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GMP and GCP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including CMOs and vendors.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

The Team

You will be part of a highly competent team focused on GMP applicable to packaging and labelling of supplies for clinical trials, with a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness and successful collaboration with our internal stakeholders and CMOs.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Portfolio & Project Delivery and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department.

We have an international and informal working environment with a high pace, strong one-team spirit and close collaboration across functions.

Application

Has this sparked your interest? Then we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter including your motivation for this position. We screen candidates on a continuous basis and call in for interviews.

Fully remote applicants will not be considered, so please indicate if you are willing to relocate if you’re not currently living in commute distance.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

At Twinspire, we're building a digital twin platform for individualised athlete modelling in elite football. We are already testing this live in clubs through ongoing pilot studies.

The question we care about is simple: can data-driven signals actually support decisions that practitioners trust?

The role

We're looking for a physiotherapist, sports medicine professional, or physician with experience in elite or semi-elite football. Not to validate what we're building, but to challenge it.

This is not a narrow return-to-play role. We're looking for someone who can connect:

• physiology

• data

• research

• and real-world decision-making

You understand that athlete management is not clean or protocol-driven, but contextual, uncertain, and often subjective. That's exactly the gap we're trying to close.

What you will do

You will work directly with the founding team and DTU research group.

You will:

• Pressure-test whether model outputs make sense physiologically

• Call out when signals don't translate to real decisions

• Help bridge the gap between research and applied practice

• Shape what a useful signal actually looks like in elite environments

• Push us to build something that holds up under scrutiny, not just in theory

What we are looking for

Someone who:

• Has worked closely with elite or semi-elite football players

• Brings strong physiological and/or sports medicine expertise

• Is comfortable questioning both data and established practice

• Has felt the gap between what's measured and what's actually useful

• Wants to be part of defining what better looks like

What we offer

• Direct involvement in a validation study with elite football clubs across the Nordics

• Opportunity for research co-authorship

• Equity participation

• A chance to shape how athlete modelling is applied in real environments

If this resonates, reach out: roxane@twinspire.ai
